A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Emergent Misalignment study and contain readable main text, figures, tables and Appendices A–G. Figure relocation, renumbering and appendix pagination changes can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v5.pdf reports original finetuning experiments, benchmark evaluations, control comparisons and ablations, including Table 1 and the additional results in Appendices C–G.

after.justification: v7.pdf retains these original empirical results, including insecure-code finetuning, backdoor experiments, training dynamics, number-sequence experiments and base-model evaluations.

M1.justification: The finetuning procedures, model variants, objectives and inference procedures are unchanged. The insecure-code, educational-control, backdoor and evil-numbers constructions match across versions.

E1.justification: Both retain the same code and number datasets, Ruby/paraphrase variants, main and preregistered questions, standard benchmarks, deception tasks and code-format/Flask evaluation scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage was added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including the original-model, secure, educational-insecure and jailbroken controls. The base-versus-instruct and judge-validation comparisons also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Training budgets, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, sampling temperature, alignment/coherence thresholds and testing procedures match. The training-dynamics and Flask-context protocols in Sections 4.7–4.8 were already present in v5.pdf.

E4.justification: The same dataset-diversity, backdoor, in-context learning, answer-format, deception, weight-decay, threshold and chat-template analyses remain. Appendix case studies and dataset-variant experiments are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Both retain bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals, Figure 4's ten insecure-model and six control-model training runs, and the five-seed ranges in Figures 11–12. No run-count or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 1 retains the free-form main misalignment increases of 0.198 ± 0.071 for insecure models and 0.005 ± 0.003 for jailbroken models, relative to GPT-4o. Table 5, all matched plots and appendix qualitative examples likewise retain their results.

T1.justification: The mathematical evaluation definitions and log-probability constructions are unchanged. Neither version contains a formal theorem or proof development that is added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about broad misalignment from narrow finetuning, differences from jailbreaking, trigger-dependent behavior, and findings for numbers and base models.

C2.justification: Section 6 preserves the same persona-based explanation and limitations concerning two datasets, unexplained model differences and simplistic evaluations. Qualifications about judge errors, base-model classification and dataset-variant experiments also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v7.pdf removes the standalone Data availability and Code availability statements, including explicit identification of training/evaluation code and OpenAI reproduction instructions. The introduction retains the dataset repository link, and implementation details remain unchanged. This is reduced disclosure, not evidence that resources became unavailable.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged, including comparisons with reward tampering, alignment faking, finetuning attacks and concurrent misalignment-related work.

P1.justification: v7.pdf adds an appendix contents page, changes equal-contribution symbols and updates Appendix A to credit Niels Warncke with writing Sections 4.7–4.8. Scientific prose and section order remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 10–15 are relocated nearer their discussion; the base-model results and Flask prompt exchange Figure 14/15 numbering. v7.pdf also removes appendix margin line numbers and adds the contents-page layout. Existing graphics and table designs are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: The empirical evidence, reasoning and limitations are unchanged. The appendix contents page and closer figure placement modestly improve navigation, while removing the explicit code/reproduction statement weakens guidance. With the repository link and implementation details retained, these limited presentation and disclosure changes leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
